title: Huang's 'AGI has arrived' X post keeps Anthropic-OpenAI frontier debate alive a week on
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's September 4 X post that 'AGI has arrived' continues to shape the narrative around GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 a week later, with Greg Brockman reframing AGI as 'a mission concept or spiritual concept' rather than a milestone. The exchange underlines how frontier labs and chip vendors are converging on benchmark-based marketing rather than agreed technical thresholds, and keeps enterprise buyers guessing on which model to standardise around through year-end.
